import urllib.request
import re

data = urllib.request.urlopen('https://www.turbinist.ru/860-dlya-oznakomleniya-polzovatelyam.html', timeout=15).read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')

m = re.search(r'<div[^>]*class="[^"]*full-article-content[^"]*"[^>]*>', data, re.DOTALL)
if m:
    start = m.end()
    text = data[start:start+15000]
    text = re.sub(r'<br\s*/?>', '\n', text)
    text = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', '', text)
    text = re.sub(r' ', ' ', text)
    text = re.sub(r'—', '—', text)
    text = re.sub(r'«|»', '"', text)
    text = re.sub(r'"', '"', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\n\s*\n', '\n\n', text)
    text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', text)
    print(text.strip())
else:
    print("full-article-content not found")
    # Debug: find all major divs
    for m2 in re.finditer(r'<div[^>]*class="([^"]+)"', data):
        cls = m2.group(1)
        if 'content' in cls or 'story' in cls or 'text' in cls or 'article' in cls or 'full' in cls:
            print(f"Found div: {cls}")
